skills.name: Hunter's Path
skills.description:
## Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Heavy Attack - Steelclash

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after performing Heavy Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

## Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Mid-air Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

## Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep

When Prowess is full, Heavy Attack - Steelclash is replaced with Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
- While in action, release or press Normal Attack again within a certain period to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

## Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash

Augusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing Electro DMG.

## Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut

Press Jump when Prowess is full to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, press Resonance Skill or Jump to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting Heavy Attack - Steelclash or Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash, release Normal Attack after a certain period or press Normal Attack or Jump again to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing, Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.

## Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash

When Prowess is full, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

## Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep

When Ascendancy is full, press Normal Attack following a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep in place of Dodge Counter and Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Release or press Normal Attack again within a certain period into the action to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

## Prowess

Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Prowess.
- Prowess is obtained when Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Steelclash, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Dodge Counter, or Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash deals damage.
- Prowess is fully restored when casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare.

skills.name: Warrior's Blade
skills.description: Augusta leaps and slams down her Broadblade, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Sunward Conquest
skills.description:
## Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath

Press and release Resonance Liberation to cast this skill. Augusta will sweep her Broadblade forward, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

## Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun

When Majesty reaches 2 stacks, hold Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun. Casting Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun costs no Resonance Energy but 2 stacks of Majesty instead.
- When casting Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun, Augusta generates the Ruler's Realm and enters the Sworn Allegiance state for 7s. Within this duration, time is temporarily stopped, and Resonator switching is disabled. Only Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector, and Dodge can be performed in the Sworn Allegiance state. Mid-air Attack is available while airborne.
- In the Sworn Allegiance state, press or hold Normal Attack to cast Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne. Augusta can walk on water without consuming STA in this state.
- Performing environmental, gameplay, or other interactions ends Sworn Allegiance without triggering Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

## Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne

Deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. After casting Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne 9 times, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to perform Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

## Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector

Deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector ends the Sworn Allegiance state and consumes all stacks of Crown of Wills later. All other Resonators in the team will be made to leave the field.
- When Sworn Allegiance ends, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector is automatically cast.
- During Sworn Allegiance, hold Resonance Liberation to cast Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector early.

## Ruler's Realm

- Ruler's Realm lasts for 30s.
- When Resonators in the team cast Intro Skill within Ruler's Realm, they gain a shield equal to 650 + 5% of Augusta's Max HP for 10s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

## Majesty

Augusta can hold up to 2 stacks of Majesty.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when casting Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when other Resonators in the team cast Outro Skill under the effect of Augusta's Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding.

skills.name: Glory's Favor
skills.description: When Augusta deals damage, she gains a shield equal to 350 + 2.5% of her Max HP for 5s, triggered once every 0.5s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

skills.name: Blazing Valor
skills.description:
When Augusta is out of combat for over 4s, she gains the following effects that can be triggered once every 4s:
- If Majesty is less than 1 stack, restore 1 stack.
- Fully restore Crown of Wills.

skills.name: Stride of Goldenflare
skills.description: Deal Electro DMG.

skills.name: Call Me By the Sun
skills.description:
## Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike

When Ascendancy is full, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade is replaced with Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
- Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can be cast mid-air.

## Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap

Deal Electro DMG.
- Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can only be cast mid-air.

## Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge

Consume all Ascendancy to cast this skill, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill grants 1 stack of Majesty.
- Can only be cast mid-air.

## Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike

When Ascendancy is full, press Resonance Skill after a successful ground Dodge or press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill after successful Mid-air Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast again some time after being interrupted.

## Ascendancy

Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Ascendancy.
- Ascendancy is obtained when Normal Attacks deal damage.
- Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare restores 20% Ascendancy.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade restores 10% Ascendancy.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath restores 40% Ascendancy.

skills.name: Battlesong of the Unyielding
skills.description:
The next Resonator switched onto the field gains the following effects for 14s, which end immediately if they are switched out:
- Gain 15% DMG Amplification for all Attributes.
- Casting Outro Skill grants 1 stacks of Majesty and 1 stacks of Crown of Wills to Augusta.

## Crown of Wills

Each stack grants 15% Electro DMG Bonus, up to 1 stack. When Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector ends, all stacks of Crown of Wills are removed.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap, and Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge are now immune to interruption.

- For every 1% of Crit. Rate over 100%, Augusta gains 2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 100%.

- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Sunborne, Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector.

sequences.description: Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Unshaken in Wrathful Tides
sequences.description: The Shield provided by Inherent Skill - Glory's Favor is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Engraved in Radiant Light
sequences.description:
- Augusta can now hold up to 4 stacks of Crown of Wills.
- For every 1% of Crit. Rate over 150%, Augusta gains 2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 50%.
- When Augusta performs Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash or Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, she obtains 2 stack of Crown of Wills. Augusta can only obtain 2 stacks of Crown of Wills every 1s via Engraved in Radiant Light.
- While casting Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash or Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, Thunder Rage is triggered at the spot, dealing two instances of Electro DMG, with each instance equal to 100% of Augusta's ATK, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

## Heavy Attack

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Cogitation Model
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. Enter Intuition.
When in Intuition:
-Obtain 3 Hypercube(s). Each time Resonance Skill Law of Reigns is cast, consume 1 Hypercube(s). Intuition ends once all Hypercubes are consumed.
-Basic Attack and Heavy Attack are replaced with Basic Attack Pivot - Impale, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
-Resonance Skill Deduction is replaced with Resonance Skill Divergence, which deals Electro DMG.
-Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter Unfathomed, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

skills.name: Knowing
skills.description: Gain 5% Electro DMG Bonus after casting Resonance Skill for 8s, stackable for up to 4 times.

skills.name: Focus
skills.description: When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation, Xiangli Yao's resistance to interruption is enhanced.

skills.name: Principle
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Forever Seeking
skills.description:
## Resonance Skill - Decipher

When Capacity reaches 100, Resonance Skill Deduction is replaced by Resonance Skill Decipher.
Consume 100 Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Decipher, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

## Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns

When Performance Capacity reaches 5 in Intuition state, Resonance Skill Divergence is replaced by Resonance Skill Law of Reigns.
Consume 5 Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Law of Reigns, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

## Mid-air Attack - Revamp

Shortly after casting Resonance Skill Decipher or Resonance Skill Divergence, use Basic Attack to perform Mid-air Attack Revamp at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

## Capacity

Xiangli Yao can hold up to 100 Capacity.
Every Normal Attack Probe on hit grants Capacity.
Every Resonance Skill Deduction on hit grants Capacity.

## Performance Capacity

Xiangli Yao can hold up to 5 Performance Capacity.
When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation:
Obtain 1 Performance Capacity when Stage 1 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity when Stage 2 or 3 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Resonance Skill Divergence on hit.
Obtain 3 Performance Capacity for every Mid-air Attack Revamp on hit.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Dodge Counter Unfathomed on hit.

skills.name: Chain Rule
skills.description: Xiangli Yao will call down a laser beam upon the first target the incoming Resonator's Basic Attack hits, dealing Electro DMG equal to 237.63% of Xiangli Yao's ATK to an area. This effect lasts for 8s and can be triggered once every 2s, up to 3 times.

sequences.name: Prodigy of Protégés

sequences.name: Traces of Predecessors

Decipher, Deduction, Divergence, and Law of Reigns.
This effect can be triggered up to 5 times.

sequences.name: Solace of the Ordinary
sequences.description: The Hypercubes obtained from Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model are enhanced, increasing the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Law of Reigns by 76%.

skills.name: Zapstring's Dance
skills.description:
## Basic Attack

Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Heavy Attack

Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing Electro DMG.

## Mid-air Attack

Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Magnetic Roar
skills.description:
## Magnetic Roar

The puppet "Zapstring" deals Electro DMG to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill Execution Mode.

## Execution Mode

Basic Attack and Dodge Counter will trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast when hitting a target.
Each stage of Basic Attack or Dodge Counter can only trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast, up to 4 times.

## Electromagnetic Blast

Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit Sinner's Mark, dealing Electro DMG.

## Lightning Execution

Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar to cast Lightning Execution to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
If Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.

skills.name: Thundering Wrath
skills.description: Command "Zapstring" to call for thunder to fall upon a large range, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Pain Immersion
skills.description: After using Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar, Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 5s.

skills.name: Deadly Focus
skills.description: The damage of Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is increased by 10% when hitting targets marked with Sinner's Mark, and Yinlin's ATK is increased by 10% for 4s when this is triggered.

skills.name: Raging Storm
skills.description: Command puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing Electro DMG in a large range.

skills.name: Chameleon Cipher
skills.description:
## Chameleon Cipher

When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with Chameleon Cipher, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. When it hits a target marked with Sinner's Mark, the Sinner's Mark is replaced with Punishment Mark, lasting for 18s. Chameleon Cipher deals Heavy Attack DMG.

## Sinner's Mark

## Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders

Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Thunder from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders, healing all nearby Resonators in the team once per second for 8s.

When holding Normal Attack with fewer than 2 Trigrams, Buling fails the divination, becoming temporarily immobilized and losing all Trigrams and 20% of her current HP. This effect will not consume HP if Buling's current HP is below 1%.

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to perform Basic Attack Stage 3, dealing Electro DMG.
- After performing Dodge Counter, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 4.

## Trigram

Buling can hold up to 4 Trigrams. When Trigrams reach the max number, gaining new Trigrams moves all Trigrams 1 slot to the left, and the original leftmost Trigram will be removed.
- Trigram - Mountain is obtained when Basic Attack Stage 2 deals damage.

Yuanwu summons Thunder Wedge, dealing Electro DMG, and forms a Thunder Field centered on the Thunder Wedge. Thunder Wedge lasts for 12s.
Forte Circuit Rumbling Spark and Resonance Liberation Blazing Might will immediately detonate Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge on the field, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

## Thunder Field

The active character gains the effects below when in the Thunder Field: a Coordinated Attack from Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is triggered when attacks hit a target, dealing Electro DMG. This can be triggered once every 1.2s. The effect lasts for 1.5s.

skills.name: Blazing Might

skills.name: Thunderous Determination

## Thunder Uprising

## Lightning Infused

The character in Lightning Infused state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.
When Yuanwu is in this state:
-Basic Attacks: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Heavy Attacks: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Dodge Counters: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Use Basic Attack within 3s after casting a Heavy Attack or a successful Counterattack to cast Thunderweaver, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-Does not recover "Readiness".

## Readiness

When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu gains 6 "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains 5 "Readiness".

skills.name: Mix-'n'-Match
skills.description:
## Basic Attack - Huntress

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Heavy Attack - Huntress

Hold Normal Attack to continuously fire at enemies at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Hold and then release Normal Attack while Rebecca is not casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress to cast Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

## Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Deal Electro DMG.

## Comin' in Hot! - Huntress

Somersault in mid-air and land.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

## Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter - Huntress

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Tactical Dodge - Huntress

Press Dodge to attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
- Casting Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

## Basic Attack - Guts

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts does not reset Basic Attack - Huntress's attack cycle within a certain time.

## Heavy Attack - Guts

Consume STA and attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Mid-air Plunging Attack - Guts

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter - Guts

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Tactical Dodge - Guts

Press Dodge and attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Guts.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Guts.

skills.name: Tactical Tweaks
skills.description:
## Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!

Press Resonance Skill when in the Huntress mode to close the distance and spray lead at enemies, then switch to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!

Press Resonance Skill when in the Guts mode to spray lead at the enemy, then use recoil from shooting the ground to close the distance and switch to Huntress mode to continue the barrage, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

skills.name: Party 'til Dawn!
skills.description:
Switching to Mk. 31 HMG mode generates a field of Stagnation for 9.5s, in which:
Rebecca fires the Mk. 31 HMG automatically, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating Overload. Press or hold Normal Attack or press Resonance Liberation at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her Mk. 31 HMG's firepower and accumulate Overload faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.
- The machine gun will only auto-lock onto the enemy closest to the crosshair in the aim down sight.
- Rebecca is immobile when firing the Mk. 31 HMG and gains 50% DMG Reduction and Immunity to Interrruption.

## Overload

Rebecca can hold up to 90 points of Overload.
Hitting targets with the standard firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 2 points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 4 points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 6 points.

## BOOM! Fireworks!

After Mk. 31 HMG mode ends or when Overload is maxed, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast, dealing Electro DMG. Casting BOOM! Fireworks! ends  Mk. 31 HMG.
- Hold Resonance Liberation while in Mk. 31 HMG mode to immediatly cast BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Leaving the Mk. 31 HMG mode removes all Overload.

skills.name: Tag, You're It!
skills.description:
ATK is increased by 10% for 12s when A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, or when Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts is cast, stacking up to 2 times.
When a Resonator in the team inflicts Hack - Shifting, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 30 for 30s.

skills.name: Left an Opening!
skills.description:
Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress and Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts gain increased resistance to interruption.
When Rebecca casts Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.

skills.name: My Turn!
skills.description:
## Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!

When in the Huntress mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy and sprays lead with Huntress, then switches to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!

When in the Guts mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of Guts from shooting the ground and switches to the Huntress mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

skills.name: Gloves Are Comin' Off!
skills.description:
## Switch Gears!

Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes.
- The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

## Hack - Shifting

Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

## Hack Response - Meltdown

Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

## Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress

At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress is replaced with Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

## Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts

At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack  to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

## Fervor

Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Fervor.
Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 points of Fervor.

## Hot Hand

Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 points per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 points.

## A Girl Gets What She Wants!

At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill -  It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the Huntress and Guts modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
Hot Hand cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 points per second.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Preem Choom
skills.description:
Summon a turret that continuously attacks enemies for 14s, dealing 2.5% Electro DMG each hit.
The incoming Resonator gains Edgerunner Bonds, granting 15% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Resonators with Edgerunner Bonds gain 1 stacks of Overlimit every 0.2s, each stack granting 0.5% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, up to 35% (Lucy automatically receives max stacks when her Edgerunner Bonds is active). Switching to another Resonator ends Edgerunner Bonds and Overlimit early.
Lucy can enhance the turret, increasing its DMG Multiplier by 250%, but its on-field duration will be lowered to 4s.

skills.name: Hack - Meltdown
skills.description:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Rebecca can cast Tune Break on the target.

Rebecca can inflict Hack - Shifting and respond to Hack - Interfered on targets.
Responding to Hack - Interfered:  When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts the Hack - Interfered, Rebecca triggers Hack - Meltdown on the target.  Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.

sequences.name: Try Not to Get in the Way!
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of the following skills are increased by 50%:
- Basic Attack - Huntress, Heavy Attack - Huntress, Tactical Dodge - Huntress, and Dodge Counter - Huntress
- Basic Attack - Guts, Tactical Dodge - Guts, Dodge Counter - Guts.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, Rebecca gains 3 additional stack of Street Smarts for 12s. Upon performing Tactical Dodge - Huntress or Tactical Dodge - Guts, if Rebecca has sufficient Street Smarts stacks, 1 stack will be consumed to restore 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation BOOM! Fireworks! is immune to interruption.

sequences.name: Oh, Hey Choom!
sequences.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, or Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, they gain 15% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
Hot Hand regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.

sequences.name: Don't Sweat Your Six!
sequences.description:
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks! gain 60% DMG Multiplier increase.
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! gains 30% more explosion range.
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! grants 120 points of Hot Hand.

sequences.name: Got Ya Covered!
sequences.description: Rebecca gains an additional 60% Stat Bonus increase from the A Girl Gets What She Wants! effect.

sequences.name: Dreamin' on the Edge
sequences.description: Rebecca gains 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 8s when she inflicts Hack - Shifting.

sequences.name: Maybe, Just Maybe...
sequences.description:
Rebecca's Basic Attack DMG Bonus from every source is increased by 40%.
During Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, Rebecca deals an additional instance of Electro DMG equal to 900% of her ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca recovers an additional 20 points of Hot Hand when she is casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts.
When Rebecca takes a fatal blow, she does not fall to the damage and instead restores fixed 2077 HP for 5 times immediately. This effect is triggered once every 10 min.
When Rebecca stays out of combat for more than 4s, she restores 120 point of Fervor. This effect is triggered once every 4s.

skills.name: Deterrence
skills.description:
## Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Parry Stance

Hold Normal Attack to enter Parry Stance at the cost of STA.
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes 60% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release Normal Attack to exit Parry Stance and perform Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble to cast Mid-air Attack - Havoc
In Parry Stance, use Dodge to consume STA to perform Dodge: Flicker, which can trigger successful Dodges during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

## Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

## Mid-air Attack - Havoc

Perform up to 3 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Stage 3 of this skill to perform Basic Attack - Repel.

## Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

## Mid-air Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.description: Launch the Cloudrift Bolt and grapple towards the target, dealing Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after to cast Basic Attack - Repel, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate Tactics
skills.description: Launch the Thunder Quietus, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Decipher
skills.description: Resonance Skill Overshock inflicts 10 stacks of Electro Flare on the target it damages.

skills.name: Regression
skills.description: When Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, gain 20% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 20s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

skills.name: Thunderous Fury
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Myriad Omens' Mandate
skills.description:
## Overshock

At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Normal Attack Stage 4.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by pressing the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 points of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.

## Apex Resonance

While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes 10% Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, press Resonance Skill to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last 1 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, press Resonance Skill to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next 2 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. Press Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, press Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

## Electric Surge

Rover can hold up to 120 points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.

## Thunder Rage

Rover can hold up to 100 points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Rumbling Thunders
skills.description:
The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for 20s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, their Electro Core is consumed, and they gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the Apex Resonance state and clears all Thunder Rage.

skills.name: Tune Break - Sword
skills.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

sequences.name: Celestial Ingenuity
sequences.description: While casting Normal Attack and Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds, gain increased resistance to interruption for 0.5s.

sequences.name: Thousandfold Artifice
sequences.description: Inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the targets hit after Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics deals damage.

sequences.name: Alchemy of Wonders
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Overshock is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Earthquaking Rumble
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Principle of Change
sequences.description: Crit. DMG is increased by 20% while in Apex Resonance.

sequences.name: Mind's Depths in a Casket
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds and Thunder Bane is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Manifold Bloom
skills.description:
## Basic Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Heavy Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, consume STA to deal Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

## Mid-air Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form and in mid-air, press Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

## Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

While in Answering Form and in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, continuously consuming STA and dealing Electro DMG to the target.
Depleting all STA or switching to another Resonator ends the skill action early.

## Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

When the Normal Attack button is released during Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, Hsin casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, transforming into the Moon Fox upon landing and dealing Electro DMG.
After casting Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

## Dodge Counter - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

## Basic Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 generates a Modular Heartlock at the target's position. Casting Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form causes the Modular Heartlock to collapse, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting this skill consumes STA when Hsin is in mid-air.

## Heavy Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form, consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3.

## Upward Cut - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and on the ground, press Jump to cast this skill, dealing Electro DMG.

## Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is in mid-air, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3.

## Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form and in the Mechanism Dominion state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form and in the Mechanism Dominion state, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Stage 3.

skills.name: Heartward by Moon
skills.description:
## Resonance Skill - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4.
Can be cast in mid-air.

If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, she turns into the Moon Fox.
- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin gains Dustless Tread. With Dustless Tread, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. Dustless Tread is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the Moon Fox form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin restores 6% of Max HP every 3s.
- Taking damage, failing to perform a Dodge with directional input while on the ground, or Dodging in mid-air will end the Moon Fox form. Switching to another Resonator or pressing Resonance Skill also ends the Moon Fox form. Press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4, which also ends the Moon Fox form.
- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.
- Resonance Liberation is disabled when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.

## Resonance Skill - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Nexus Alight
skills.description:
## Formshift

Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector unlocks Formshift.
Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.

## Pillars Across Heaven

After casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, when in Illumining Form with full Resonance Energy, Pillars Across Heaven becomes available.
Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.

## Edict

Casting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG.
- Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.

## Heart Manifest

Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.
While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.
Besides, if Hsin is still in Illumining Form after exiting Heart Manifest, and Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering.

## Invoked Form: Answering

Hsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

## Invoked Form: Illumining

Hsin turns back into Illumining Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Upward Cut - Illumining Form; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.

skills.name: Tides of Succession
skills.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, when Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, Her ATK is increased by 50% for 8s. Switching to another Resonator or Resonance Mode ends this effect.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare, Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Gleaning Simple Joys
skills.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, the maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare and Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict Electro Flare on a target, every 1 stack of Electro Flare inflicted grants Hsin1 stack of Thunderglow, stacking up to 10 times.
While Hsin is in the Heart Manifest state, when targets within a certain range have 0 stacks of Electro Flare, inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the targets. If Thunderglow on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the target, She also inflicts Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- When Fleeting Thunder is active, if the maximum stacks of Electro Flare on the target is increased, Hsin will inflict Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- Fleeting Thunder will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the Heart Manifest state or switching Resonance Mode removes the aforementioned effects.

skills.name: Glance on a Whim
skills.description:
## Intro Skill - Answering Form

This skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3 (when in Resonance Mode - Unison) or Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4 (when in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare).

## Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison

This skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

## Intro Skill - Illumining Form

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

## Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.

skills.name: Forms Turn, Heart Abides
skills.description:
## Forms Born of Heart

While in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

## Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer

While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

## Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Can be cast in mid-air.

## Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

## Mechanism Dominion

The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

## Resonance Mode - Unison

While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

## Resonance Mode - Electro Flare

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 times. Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit.

## Unison

While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.

## Unison Response

While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response after She is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 stacks of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon in this way.

## Unison Boon

Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger Unison Response in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

## Answering Heart

Can hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.
While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.
Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.

## Illumining Heart

Can hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.
While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, or Intro Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, additionally gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator in Illumining Form but not in the Mechanism Dominion state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Herself a Thousand Lanterns
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 100% of Hsin's ATK.
Hsin gains Nightglow upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven. When Hsin casts Outro Skill, Nightglow is consumed to trigger various effects depending on the Resonance Mode She is in:
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain Shared Light when they gain Unison. After Hsin casts Outro Skill, Resonators with Shared Light gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain 20% Electro DMG Amplification for 20s.
The above effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

sequences.name: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
sequences.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin 2 stacks of Radiance Ward, stacking up to 2 times. Switching to Answering Form clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of Radiance Ward can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison are increased by 15%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison by 10%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When Hsin enters combat, if Heart of Thunder is below 50 stacks, it is increased to 50 stacks, triggered once every 12s.
The DMG Multiplier of the Electro Flare DMG triggered by Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon is increased to 42% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).

sequences.name: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector are increased by 60%.
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons are increased by 60%.

When Hsin enters combat, reset the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain Resolution of Wishes and Law of Heaven, and restore 100 additional points of Answering Heart. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

sequences.name: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 70%.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 20%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases its Crit. DMG by 15%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When the last stage of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven hits a target inflicted with Electro Flare, it triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 1500% times the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current Electro Flare stacks on the target.

sequences.name: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
sequences.description:
All Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s when a Resonator in the team triggers any of the following actions:
- Inflict Electro Flare or Electro Rage on a target.
- Gain Unison while not having the effect.
- Trigger Unison Response.

sequences.name: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
sequences.description:
While in Illumining Form, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by 20%.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores 100% of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute.

sequences.name: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living
sequences.description:
Targets take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are additionally increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team additionally gain 1 stack of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
While in combat, Electro Flare DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at 80% and Crit. DMG fixed at 230%.

skills.name: Furled Canopy
skills.description:
## Basic Attack

Press or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

## Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy

While in the Deep Mind state, Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, performing up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 1 and Stage 2 in succession.
Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1 and Stage 2 in succession, dealing Electro DMG.
Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4.
Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1, press or hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2.

## Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder

Deal Electro DMG.

## Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

## Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
- While in the Deep Mind state, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy.
- Shortly after casting the skill, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

## Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
- Shortly after casting the skill, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3.
- Shortly after casting the skill, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Furled Canopy: Rift Cleaver
skills.description:
Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG.
- Within a certain period after opening the umbrella and dashing forward, when attacked by an enemy target, Suoming becomes immune to this damage and stagnates nearby targets. She then becomes immune to interruption and receives 100% less DMG for a certain period, and casts Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam.
- Entering the Deep Mind state resets the Cooldown of Resonance Skill.
- While in the Awakened Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
- While in the Deep Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3.

## Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam

Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG.
- While in the Awakened Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
- While in the Deep Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4.

skills.name: Umbral Canopy: Miasma Lock
skills.description:
While in the Deep Mind state, Resonance Liberation becomes available. Casting Resonance Liberation deals Electro DMG to targets within range.
- Casting Resonance Liberation grants Suoming Unison for 5s.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

## Blight Rain, Miasmic Thunder

While casting Outro Skill, if Suoming has Unison, when a Resonator on the field deals damage, a Thunder Crest is summoned as a Coordinated Attack on the target, dealing Electro DMG.
- Within 3s after this damage is dealt, a Thunder Crest can be summoned each second. This effect is triggered once per second. The damage dealt by Thunder Crest does not trigger this effect.
- Only 1 Thunder Crest can be summoned per second, up to 6 in total.
- This effect lasts 8s, or until the number of summoned Thunder Crest reaches the limit.

skills.name: Rain-Soaked Covenant
skills.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift, Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending, Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison), or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) grants 50% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.
- When Suoming casts Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison) or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison), she additionally gains 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered only once every 25s.

skills.name: Sunken Seal, Forged Lock
skills.description:
When Suoming has Unison and casts Outro Skill, she gains the Aligned Seals effect for 30s.
Within 8s after Suoming casts Resonance Liberation or Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart, if she gains or has Aligned Seals, her Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 30% Electro DMG Bonus, plus an additional 20% for each stack of Unison Boon they have, up to 40%. This effect lasts for 8s or until the Resonator is switched out.

When Suoming has Unison, casting Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Rift Cleaver removes Unison and the Unison Boon on her, consumes 20 points of Concerto Energy, and clears all Delusion, granting the Seal Master effect: the DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy and Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder are increased by 100%, each stage of both skills restores 5 additional points of Concerto Energy on hit, and Suoming's Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. This effect lasts for 12s or until the Resonator is switched out.
- Gaining Unison ends this effect early.
- Gaining the Aligned Seals effect ends this effect early.
- The Seal Master effect cannot be gained while the Aligned Seals effect is active.
- While the Seal Master effect is active, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4 to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2.

skills.name: Furled Canopy: Flash Rift
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- While in the Awakened Mind state, casting this skill sends Suoming into the Deep Mind state and clears all Delusion.
- While in the Deep Mind state, Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending.
- While in the Awakened Mind state, triggering Unison Response replaces Intro Skill with Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison).
- While in the Deep Mind state, triggering Unison Response replaces Intro Skill with Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison).

## Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending

Deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2.

## Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison)

Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into the Deep Mind state and clears all Delusion.

## Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)

Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- While in the Deep Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2.

skills.name: Bound Obsession, Forged Mind
skills.description:
## Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion

While in the Awakened Mind state, when Delusion reaches 800 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into Deep Mind and clears all Delusion.

## Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind

While in the Deep Mind state, when Delusion reaches 800 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, pulling in nearby targets and dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

## Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart

Within a certain period after casting Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, Basic Attack and Resonance Skill are replaced with Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart. Press or hold Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to cast this skill. Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into Calamity Mind and clears all Delusion; she enters Awakened Mind once the skill ends.
- When casting this skill, hold Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to continuously attack the target for a certain period.
- While casting this skill, Suoming is immune to DMG and interruption for a certain period.
- During the skill action, she cannot move, dash, jump, dodge, or cast Basic Attack, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, Dodge Counter, Plunging Attack, Mid-air Attack, or Intro Skill, and Resonator switching is also restricted.

## Unison

When Suoming has Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove her Unison to trigger Suoming's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. When Suoming's Concerto Energy is full and she has Unison, only the Unison effect is consumed.

## Unison Response

Suoming can trigger Unison Response.
When the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Suoming triggers Unison Response after she is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting all Resonators in the team 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s.
Suoming can grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon. Gaining it again only resets the duration.
Unison Response cannot be triggered in Co-op.

## Unison Boon

Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators in the team who can trigger Unison Response by 3%, up to 2 stacks.

## Delusion

Can hold up to 800 points of Delusion.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder, Dodge Counter, Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy, or Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam grants Delusion if Suoming is the active Resonator.
- Casting Resonance Liberation grants 200 points of Delusion.
- Casting Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) grants 200 points of Delusion.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Canopy Rumble
skills.description: The incoming Resonator gains 20% Electro DMG Amplification for 8s or until the Resonator is switched out. While having Unison Boon, they also gain 25% Resonance Skill DMG Amplification.

skills.name: Tune Break - Sword
skills.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

sequences.name: Into the Blight Rain
sequences.description:
Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind is immune to interruption.
The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift, Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending, Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison), and Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) are increased by 60%.

sequences.name: Breaking Thunder, Slaying Evil
sequences.description:
Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
Casting Outro Skill increases the incoming Resonator's Crit. DMG by 10%, plus an additional 6% for each stack of Unison Boon they have, up to 24%. This effect lasts for 30s or until the Resonator is switched out.

sequences.name: Lone Canopy, Solitary Road
sequences.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending grants 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
- If Suoming has already granted Unison Boon and it is still in effect, gaining it again only resets its duration.

Casting Resonance Liberation grants Suoming 30% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 25s.

sequences.name: Covenant Borne Upon the Heart
sequences.description: Suoming's ATK is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Seal Deep, Never Forgotten
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Umbral Canopy: Miasma Lock is increased by 40%.

sequences.name: Nine Shadows at Her Side
sequences.description:
The effect of each stack of Unison Boon on all Resonators in the team is increased by 50%, up to 4 stacks of Unison Boon.
The DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart is increased by 50%.
When Suoming has Seal Master, her Crit. DMG is further increased by 200%.

skills.name: Such is Light
skills.description:
## Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.

## Heavy Attack

Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing Spectro DMG.

## Mid-air Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Spectro DMG. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
Press Normal Attack or Jump to perform Basic Attack Stage 2 and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Dissection when the input is Normal Attack.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Resection when the input is Jump. He also inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s and reduces DMG taken by 15% for 1s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

## Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

skills.name: Reunion of All the Fallen
skills.description:
## Golden Reflux

Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG. Inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s.
Golden Reflux has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.

## Aureole of Execution

Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack Stage 3 replaces Resonance Skill with Aureole of Execution, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s.
Aureole of Execution has 3 forms, including Aureole of Execution: Ring, Aureole of Execution: Breach, and Aureole of Execution: Glare.
Casting any form of Aureole of Execution grants 1 stacks of Endnotes on the Endgame and switches Aureole of Execution to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of Aureole of Execution and Resonance Skill is reset to Golden Reflux.
Can be cast in mid-air.

## Aureole of Execution: Ring

Deal Spectro DMG, and reset the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

## Aureole of Execution: Breach

Spin and dash forward, dealing Spectro DMG to enemies along the path and resetting the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an Ichor Blade.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

## Aureole of Execution: Glare

Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing Spectro DMG and forming an Ichor Deposit on the ground.

## Basic Attack - Golden Impale

Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

## Ichor Deposit

Ichor Deposit detonates automatically after 5s, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

## Endnotes on the Endgame

Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Casting Rewritten in Winter's Margins or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.

skills.name: Rewritten in Winter's Margins
skills.description:
Deal Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Pulses Under the Snow
skills.description:
When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by Tune Strain - Interfered:
- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's Tune Strain - Interfered stacks.

## Perpetuating Daytime

- When Resonators in the team casts Tune Break, if the target is affected by Tune Strain - Shifting,  Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, up to the target's current Tune Strain - Interfered stack cap. Cooldown: 1s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to 2 times.

skills.name: Uncaused Diagnosis
skills.description:
When Luuk Herssen's skills directly damage targets affected by Tune Strain - Interfered, every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has Amplifies this instance of damage by 5%, up to 30%.
After any nearby Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the enemies or deals Tune Break DMG, Luuk Herssen's ATK increases by 25% for 20s.

skills.name: Before Injection of Dawn
skills.description:
Deal Spectro DMG. Hurl out an Ichor Blade and inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target.
Press Normal Attack after this skill to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Dissection or Jump to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Resection.

skills.name: Spark from the Frost
skills.description:
## Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker

When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution: Glare is hurled out, press Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker.
